selection.basis: Q00014/C00120 independently accepted A00112 material content (77/77 source/Korean semantic pairs, 77/77 stock decoded-alpha metrics, 2 preserve-only structural regions) and returned only the immutable-producer durability defect. This run re-emits that accepted material unchanged with the A00123 task record in the same commit; no heavy stock QA is repeated.

material_advance.description: Directly decoded three exact pinned stock DXT5 DDS blobs and exact stock atlases from GitHub. Readable Y-reconciled decoded alpha resolves every visible localizable source label to its sprite without list-order inference, measures stock effect-inclusive alpha bboxes/counts, and classifies the two non-text regions in index147 for preservation. Stock metrics are reconstruction priors only; canonical 4x Release binary bodies remain unavailable through the GitHub connector and all Release/CLEAN_PLATE/candidate gates remain fail-closed.
